`make lint` passes now. The linter flagged one problem: in `notes/hooks.py`, `on_save(doc, ctx)` took a `ctx` argument and never used it (rule ARG001).

I deleted the parameter instead of silencing the check. Renaming it to `_ctx` or adding a `noqa` comment would have hidden the problem. Its only two callers, `save` and `autosave`, are in the same file. They now call `on_save(doc)`, and each still does its own `ctx.append(...)` before that call, so what ends up in `ctx` hasn't changed. Nothing else in the repo, including `tests/`, references `on_save`.

The test suite also passes (`pytest -q tests`: 1 passed).
